boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UMass Lowell spaces with documented student-facing uses, spanning study, well-being, recreation and campus community.

cards.title: Meehan Student Center
cards.subtitle: East Campus • 100 Meehan Way
cards.notes: Use the Salem Street entrance for late study sessions Sunday through Thursday; keep plans focused on the open tables and Club Hub.
cards.short_summary: A student-center base with documented overnight weekday study access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell’s SGA says students can use the Meehan Student Center for study space 24 hours a day, five days a week, with Club Hub and open table space available.
cards.source_title: Student Resources | Student Government Association | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Students may swipe in via the Salem Street side Sunday through Thursday; food services and board rooms close at normal times.

cards.title: Club Hub
cards.subtitle: Meehan Student Center • East Campus
cards.notes: Bring a group project, use the open tables, or warm up food using the second-floor microwaves before returning to work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student-center space tied to late study access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell’s SGA identifies Club Hub as free for use, and the commuter-services page locates microwaves on the second floor of the Meehan Student Center in Club Hub.
cards.access_notes: Open-table access is documented by SGA; building access and food-service hours vary.

cards.title: Serenity Center
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Meehan Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in between classes to decompress, use the available well-being items, or reserve time ahead if your club needs evening programming.
cards.short_summary: A designated student well-being room inside the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Serenity Center is on the third floor of the Meehan Student Center and provides a space for students to unwind and use its well-being items.
cards.source_title: Serenity Center | Student Life and Well-being | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: General use is listed Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–noon and 2–5 p.m.; prayer is noon–2 p.m.; club programming after 5 p.m. requires a reservation.

cards.title: O'Leary Library
cards.subtitle: South Campus
cards.notes: Choose a first-floor study room for a focused session, then head to the third floor for open rooms, computers, puzzles, or comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: A South Campus library with study rooms and academic support nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell’s library update says O’Leary has first-floor study rooms and third-floor open study rooms, public computers, a puzzle spot and comfortable furniture.
cards.source_title: O’Leary Library Refresh Updates | MyUML | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Library layouts and service locations may change; check library hours before visiting.

cards.title: River Hawk Scholars Academy
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, O'Leary Library • South Campus
cards.notes: If you are part of RHSA, use the ground-floor welcome desk as a starting point and ask staff about the academy’s current support options.
cards.short_summary: A named student-support home inside O’Leary Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists the River Hawk Scholars Academy on the ground floor of O’Leary Library, to the left of the lobby, with weekday office hours.
cards.source_title: Student & Campus Community Spaces | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; services may be program-specific.

cards.title: Social Justice Center
cards.subtitle: Meehan Student Center 380 • East Campus
cards.notes: Visit during listed hours to connect with a student-centered campus space; confirm program details or appointments with the center before you go.
cards.short_summary: A named East Campus student-centered space with posted access hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies the Social Justice Center as a student-centered space in Meehan Student Center room 380.
cards.source_title: Student & Campus Community Spaces | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–7 p.m.; Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: LGBTQ+ Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Meehan Student Center 370 • East Campus
cards.notes: Use the listed weekday hours to visit this student-centered resource space; contact the office beforehand if you need a specific service or accommodation.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student resource center in the Meehan Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists the LGBTQ+ Resource Center as a student-centered space in Meehan Student Center room 370.
cards.source_title: Student & Campus Community Spaces | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–7 p.m.; Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 322 Aiken Street • East Campus
cards.notes: Bring your UCARD, check the facility calendar, and choose an open court, track, fitness area, or group class that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A controlled-access recreation facility with varied activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell documents a fitness center, multipurpose courts, aerobic studios and an indoor track at the Campus Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation Center | Facilities and Hours | Campus Recreation | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: A valid UCARD is required for authorized student access; check the current facility calendar and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Riverview Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: 1291 Middlesex Street • South Campus
cards.notes: Use your UCARD for entry and plan around the posted seasonal schedule; this is a practical South Campus option for an independent workout.
cards.short_summary: A South Campus recreation facility with documented student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell lists Riverview Fitness Center at 1291 Middlesex Street and states that full-time students have access at no additional cost with a valid UCARD.
cards.source_title: Member Services | Campus Recreation | UMass Lowell
cards.access_notes: Valid UCARD required; consult Campus Recreation for current seasonal operating hours.

cards.entity_name: UMass Lowell Bellegarde Boathouse and Kayak Center
cards.title: Bellegarde Boathouse and Kayak Center
cards.subtitle: 500 Pawtucket Boulevard • Lowell
cards.notes: Check the seasonal schedule and reserve a program if needed; use the listed location as the starting point for university kayak-center activities.
cards.short_summary: A university multi-use boathouse that houses the Summer Kayak Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Lowell identifies the Bellegarde Boathouse as a multi-use facility that includes the UMass Lowell Summer Kayak Center.
cards.source_title: UMass Lowell Bellegarde Boathouse | Facilities and Hours | Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Hours are seasonal and programs may require registration; verify current access with Campus Recreation.
